evidence: Matches the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and directly modifies the HTTP RPC server and bitcoin-cli to add UNIX domain socket support.
rationale: Closes long-standing feature request #5029 to support UNIX domain sockets for RPC and bitcoin-cli, allowing filesystem permission controls and avoiding TCP loopback overhead. Downstream integrators have frequently requested this capability, and the change resolves technical debt decoupling socket addressing from P2P networking.
